label: def:categorical-neutron
title: Neutron (categorical)
html:
Definition. Neutron (categorical)

The neutron is the baryon characterized by the 1 + 2 crossing partition: one up quark and two down quarks embedded in the Borromean braid \mathcal{B}_3 (Borromean quark).

  \mathfrak{n} = \mathcal{B}_3(\mathfrak{u},\mathfrak{d},\mathfrak{d})

This structure threads one \mathfrak{u} (up quark) and two \mathfrak{d} (down quarks) through the Borromean braid. The formal evaluation---comprising the normal-form construction, mass derivation, proton transition amplitude, and Coulomb charge---follows in the properties remark.
